assumptions: Owner policy: ABS only; Polymaker PolyLite ABS datasheet values (cited) used for the leaf.
Owner policy: no screws except those supplied with the OP1; this carrier uses printed insert pins and a printed actuator insert.
ASSUMED stress concentration 1.5 at the R1-filleted leaf corners (inner faces); outer faces run flush into block and pad.
Edge press (ASSUMED 3 N at the face edge 4.5 mm from the leaf mid-plane) twists the guide by 0.17 deg (in-plane leaf bending plus torsion; Poisson ratio 0.35 ASSUMED).
Printing: carrier flat on the outer face of leaf A with block and pad flush (no support under the leaves); shell rim-down with supports under the window lintel, the roof, the posts and the lug.
Assembly order: carrier in from the cavity side (+Y) until the tab meets the lug, before the switch/PCB; then both pins pressed in along -X through the block into the posts.
Rest gap: inserts printed in 0.05 mm length steps; the longest that does not operate the switch at rest is fitted (gap 0-0.05 mm above the release point side).
Force is the same anywhere on the face (translation, no lever): leaf return force plus switch force.
design_basis.summary: Separately printed ABS carrier: the face translates on two parallel leaves, rests on a shell lug, and is fixed by two diagonal press-fit pins; the switch takes the overtravel.

flexure_checks.allowance_basis: ASSUMED half of the datasheet tensile strength (yield not published); fatigue UNKNOWN.
flexure_checks.force_basis: ASSUMED press-force band 0.3-3 N anywhere on the face (translation).
flexure_checks.ratio_basis: Translation: leaves, switch and press point share the same displacement (no lever).

functions.F1_transmit_force: Transmit thumb force from the skin piece into the button.
functions.F2_guide_button: Guide the face on two parallel leaves; hold it flush at rest against the lug.
functions.F3_actuate_switch: Press the switch pin through a gap set at assembly.
functions.F4_restore_button: Return the face with the elastic leaves (no separate spring).
functions.F5_limit_overtravel: The switch takes the overtravel (no hard stop); travel is checked to the pin fully pressed.
functions.F6_connect_shell: Fix the carrier to the shell posts with press-fit pins; keep the outer skin outside the window.

Owner policy: ABS only; no screws except those supplied with the OP1.
title: Side button test subject, revision 16 (parallel-leaf ABS carrier, press-fit pins)
unverified_requirements: 押しやすさ: 平行移動のため面のどこを押しても同じ力（板バネ復帰力＋スイッチ作動力）。実機の押下感・クリック感は未試験。
Press force at the deepest pose about 2.91 N (leaves 1.44 N + largest registered switch force); the leaves add to the bare switch force.

Switch profiles (insert from datasheets): zippy_df_pin: pass (insert 1.20 mm); omron_d2f_pin: unverified (missing free_position); huano_mouse_generic: unverified (missing free_position, operating_position, plunger_width); kailh_gm20: unverified (missing free_position, operating_position, body_height, plunger_width, body_length, body_width).
Leaves: beam theory only (guided small deflection, rigid root, typical datasheet values, ASSUMED stress concentration and Poisson ratio); creep and fatigue UNKNOWN.
Switch bottoming force is carried by the switch (no hard stop); its rating is not in the registered datasheets (UNKNOWN).
Pin and insert retention in printed ABS and print accuracy of the gaps are not qualified; presses load the pins in shear.
PCB plane is ASSUMED; the real board and shell were not measured. OP1-supplied screws are not used by this carrier.
Wall checks are sampled minima of the stated parts, not a proof of minimum wall or of strength.
verification_plan: Pair overlap and bounds; declared press fits (pins in block and posts, insert in plunger).
Rest: outward translation of the face is blocked by the lug.
Press: face with insert clear of the shell by at least 0.15 mm to 1.050 mm (pin flush for the deepest registered switch plus one insert step), including the leaf shortening.
Twist: face clear of the shell and lug by at least 0.15 mm at +/-0.17 deg (edge press) 0.3 mm into the stroke and at the deepest pose; at rest the lug carries the outward side.
Carrier insertion path (+Y) clear of the shell posts and lug; pin insertion paths clear of the leaves and face.
Leaves: guided-beam stiffness (two leaves), press force with the largest registered switch force, root stress with stress concentration.
Outer form outside the side-button region matches the base skin; sampled printed walls of shell and button.
